name: Policybazaar

valuation_metrics.basis: FY27E PAT ~280 cr on current run rate; market cap ~16,800 cr

commission_guidance.risk: IRDAI consultation paper (Sep 2026) proposes commission reductions; steep cuts likely
commission_guidance.impact_estimate: 10% commission cut could reduce earnings 10-12% per Jefferies

gmv_growth.basis: Q2 FY26: 40% YoY, health segment 60% YoY, online protection 44% YoY
gmv_growth.headwind: Commission reduction may dent near-term NPA growth

catalysts: Resolution of IRDAI commission policy (Q3-Q4 FY27); lower certainty until then
Health insurance market share gains (fastest growing segment)
Product mix shift to higher-margin categories

management_guidance.ltg_profitability: Target PAT margin 15%+ by FY27-FY28 end
management_guidance.premium_target: INR 15,000+ crore insurance GWP by end of FY27-FY28
management_guidance.growth_focus: Prioritize growth over margins in FY26-FY27
management_guidance.commission_stance: Acknowledged GST and commission impacts; management maintains long-term profitability targets despite near-term headwinds
management_guidance.segment_strategy: Health insurance expansion; credit business stabilization

market_expectation_summary: Market expects 35-40% revenue growth driven by insurance (especially health) and credit stabilization, but near-term earnings revised down by 10-12% due to proposed IRDAI commission cuts. Valuation at ~60x FY27E reflects high growth but elevated uncertainty on regulatory outcome. Path to 15%+ PAT margins intact if commission environment stabilizes by FY28.

regulatory_shock.event: IRDAI consultation paper on commission reduction
